headline: Oil is now almost certain to hit $100 this month
summary: Overnight, odds of WTI oil reaching $100 in October jumped to 89%, and $105 is now a coin flip. Rate expectations didn't change (no October hike, December hike likely). Netanyahu's chances keep slipping ten days before Israel votes, Anthropic's valuation odds cooled sharply, and Russia–Ukraine diplomacy is all but priced out for 2026.

takeaways.text: WTI touching $100 this month is now 89%, up 27 pts in a day and 52 this week. $105 is 47% (up 21) and $110 is 21% (up 11). A drop back below $90 fell 21 pts to 29%. An all-time high by March is still only 21.5%, so traders see a spike, not a blowout.

Eizenkot as next prime minister is 49.8% (up 8 pts this week), and Netanyahu is down to 28.5% (down 7). About $50k of large bets went against Netanyahu overnight. Likud winning fewer than 20 seats rose 6 pts to 23%. Israel votes Oct 27.

Anthropic worth $2.5T+ by year-end fell 7 pts today to 23.5% (down 23 this week). An IPO by Dec 15 fell 7 pts to 60.5%, and 'IPO closes above $1.8T' dropped 19 pts to 47%. SpaceX holds 63% as 2026's biggest IPO.

takeaways.lead: Ukraine peace is priced out for 2026.
takeaways.text: Russia–Ukraine peace talks by Dec 31 are 35.5% (down 29 pts this week), and by Nov 30 are 20.5% (down 28). Trump meeting Putin by year-end is still 81% (up 5), so a summit doesn't mean a deal.

takeaways.lead: A Supreme Court opening is getting likelier.
takeaways.text: Justice Alito announcing his retirement by June 2027 jumped 15 pts in a day to 58.5% (thin $110k market). A vacancy before the midterms would matter for the Senate fight.

takeaways.lead: Measles is spiking (thin, but a real daily-life signal).
takeaways.text: More than 4,800 US cases by Oct 31 jumped 38 pts in a day to 69% (thin $26k market). More than 6,000 for the year is 87.5% (up 14). Worth checking vaccination status before holiday travel.

sections.title: What's new today
bullets: A new market on the next White House Press Secretary: Scott Jennings 17.5%, Anna Kelly 15% (thin $77k market). An announcement by Nov 30 is 56.5%.
2026 is now 78.5% likely to be the hottest year on record (up 21 pts this week, $3.8M market).
October US inflation (CPI) at 3.7% is 81% likely and core CPI at 2.6% is 67% (thin markets). The report is out Nov 11.

sections.title: Trading signals
bullets: Oil: WTI $100 in October 89% (up 52 pts this week), $105 47%, $110 21%. Energy stocks and tankers benefit; airlines and trucking pay more for fuel.
Fed: no change on Oct 29 is 86.5% (steady); a December hike is 76.5% (down 2). The bond market still sees yields near a peak: the 10-year reaching 5.4% this year is 36.5% (down 30 pts this week).
Largest company at year-end: Nvidia 70.5%, Apple 28% (Apple gave back some of last week's surge).
Military action against the Saudi East-West pipeline by Oct 31 rose 4 pts to 32% (thin $138k market). A hit would push oil past $110.

sections.title: Wars & geopolitics
bullets: Israel–Iran ceasefire: very likely through Oct 31 (84.5%), shakier further out (Nov 15: 68%, down 7 pts this week). $37k of large bets went on it holding through Oct 18.
The US–Iran blockade ending by year-end is 34% (down 12 pts this week). Hormuz stays effectively closed.

sections.title: Elections that move markets
bullets: Brazil runoff (Oct 25): Bolsonaro 77% (down 12 pts this week), Lula 23.5% (up 12). About $100k of large bets traded on Bolsonaro in both directions, so the market is still split.
US midterms (Nov 3): Democrats take both chambers 62.5%, Republicans keep the Senate 27.5%. Large bets: $30k+ on Democrats taking the House at 91¢, and $32k against a Republican Senate.

sections.title: Everyday life
bullets: Expect higher gas and heating costs: oil is very likely to hit $100 this month, and US inflation is running about 3.7%.
Measles: more than 6,000 US cases this year is 87.5% likely. Check vaccination status before travel.
2026 is very likely the hottest year on record (78.5%), which tends to mean higher summer power bills and insurance costs.
